title: D1 agent output (d1-chapter-picker)
description: Section 12/D1 'Agent output' line and .claude/agents/d1-chapter-picker.md's worked output shape (authoritative over the spec's prose per this project's standing precedence rule, spec 0.3): {"chapter_ids": [...] | ["unsure"], "why": str, "confidence": high|medium|low}. This schema does not exist yet in the original build (D1-D4 placeholder, config/steps.yaml) -- created as part of the D1-D4 runner-plugin build (2026-10). Cross-referencing the ids against the real chapter list given to the agent (and the 'unsure never mixed with real ids'/'at most two ids' rules) needs the per-item input context, so it lives in scripts/checks/D1.py, not here -- same split as schemas/C1.json's option_map bijection check.

chapter_ids.description: One or two real chapter ids from the list given, or exactly ["unsure"]. A second id only when the question truly needs two (agent file's own rule).

note.description: Optional. Not in d1-chapter-picker.md's own worked output example, but Universal rule 7 ('if the input looks wrong, keep to your task and say so in the note field') applies to every agent in this project including this one -- confirmed real: the first real D1 run A dispatch (Q-000015) legitimately used it to flag that neither candidate chapter actually covers the question's real content. Omitted (not required) so the two no-note worked examples stay valid too; see the build report.

oneOf.description: Universal rule 8: if the input file is missing or broken, the agent writes only {"error": "..."}.
